manifest.name: dsh-music-dj
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 AI DJ：把对话变成点歌、切歌与场景播放，驱动本机 LX Music（洛雪）完成搜索与播放。插件本身不含音源、不下载音频。

bundle.text:
# dsh-music-dj bundle patch: host half (3 tools + prompt/event wiring + HTTP API)
# and client half (mini player overlay + settings section).
# Activate with `dsh plugin add dsh-music-dj` or install from the market.
#
# 注意：name 必须是真实包名（cordis 按 name import 包）。只声明 dsh.client
# 而不声明 dsh.bundle 的仓库无法被市场收录，也会导致 `dsh plugin add` 失败。
- insert:
    - id: dsh-music-dj
      name: dsh-music-dj

readme.text:
把 DeepSeek Harness 的对话接成一台 **AI DJ**：说一句「来点适合写代码的」或「放首晴天」，DSH 就会**自己搜歌、自己切歌**。

> **本插件不含任何音源、不下载音频、不分发音源脚本。**
> 它只负责「把话变成检索词」和「遥控播放器」；真正的音源与播放都在你本机的 **[LX Music（洛雪音乐助手）](https://github.com/lyswhut/lx-music-desktop)** 里。

---

| 普通音乐插件 | 音乐 DJ |
| --- | --- |
| 需要你自己维护曲库（下载/整理/索引） | 不需要，音源由洛雪提供 |
| 模型只能「播放/暂停/下一首」 | 模型能**理解意图**：场景、情绪、具体歌曲 |
| 插件里塞解码器、代理、歌词、媒体键 | 全部交给洛雪，插件本体只有几十 KB |
| 切歌要你开口 | 开了 DJ 模式，模型会在合适的时候自己换歌 |

插件本身不能放歌。第一次使用请按下面四步准备，**只需一次**：

1. 安装 **LX Music 桌面版 ≥ 2.8**（建议 ≥ 2.12，支持 `-hidden` 托盘启动）：[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/lyswhut/lx-music-desktop/releases)
2. 打开洛雪 →「设置 → 自定义源」→ 导入一个**可用的自定义音源**（洛雪 2023 年起不再内置音源，自行选择社区源；插件不提供、不分发）
3. 打开洛雪 →「设置 → 开放 API」→ 启用（默认端口 `23330`，只监听 `127.0.0.1`）
4. 在 DSH 里打开「设置 → 音乐 DJ」→ 点「检测连接」，看到「已连接」即可

> 音源是消耗品：社区源会失效。插件在点歌失败时会明确说"没确认播放成功"，而不是假装播了。换源后重试即可。

- **插件市场**：在 DSH 插件市场搜索「音乐 DJ / dsh-music-dj」安装（推荐）。
- **命令行**：`dsh plugin add dsh-music-dj`（前提是 CLI 可用；本插件声明了 `dsh.bundle`，可被 `dsh plugin add` 安装）。
- **本地开发**：把本仓库克隆到任意目录，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `insert` 一条：

```yaml
  - insert:
      - id: dsh-music-dj
        name: dsh-music-dj
  ```

直接对 DSH 说：

- 「来点适合写代码的」→ 按场景词搜索并播放
- 「放首周杰伦的晴天」→ 精确点歌（会校验播的确实是这首）
- 「换首更安静的」→ 叠加意图重新找
- 「声音小一点」「暂停一下」「下一首」→ 控制
- 「现在放的什么」→ 读取真实状态

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `music_play` | 点歌/找歌播放：`intent`（场景）、`query`（检索词）、`title`+`artist`（精确点歌） |
| `music_control` | `play/pause/toggle/next/prev/seek/volume/mute/collect/uncollect` |
| `music_status` | 连接诊断 + 当前播放 + 最近错误 |

所有工具都返回**回读校验后的真实结果**：成功了告诉你实际在放什么，失败告诉你试过哪些检索词、大概率是哪个环节坏了。

洛雪的协议有个现实约束：**开放 API 能控制但没有搜索**，搜歌只能靠 `lxmusic://music/searchPlay/<检索词>` 这类 Scheme URL，而它是"发出去就不管了"、没有回执。所以插件采用双通道 + 回读校验：

```
用户的意图
   ↓ 模型调用 music_play(intent="写代码")
场景词表 → 检索词序列 ["lofi 纯音乐", "轻音乐 工作", ...]
   ↓ 逐条尝试

另外还做了这些：

- **动态上下文**：把「正在播放」写进模型的系统上下文（一行，≤30 token），模型不用问你就知道在放什么；
- **曲线事件**：开启 DJ 模式后，每轮对话结束、超过冷却时间、且音乐已暂停时才自动续播，绝不打断你正在听的；
- **多标签单实例**：播放状态在洛雪里，DSH 开几个标签都不会重复出声；
- **多平台**：Windows / macOS / Linux（Scheme URL 分别走 `cmd start` / `open` / `xdg-open`）。

配置文件：`~/.dsh/dsh-music-dj.json`（人类可编辑，改完重启 DSH 生效；设置页也会写这里）

```json
{
  "engine": "lx",
  "lx": { "apiPort": 23330, "exe": "" },
  "dj": { "enabled": false, "cooldownMin": 10, "autoNext": false },

- `scenes` 随便加、随便改中文；模型说「来点写代码的」时按这里的词去搜；
- `dj.enabled` 默认关——**不主动打扰**，想让它自己切歌再打开；
- 端口不是 23330 就改 `lx.apiPort`；洛雪装在非默认路径就填 `lx.exe`。

- 插件**不内置、不分发任何音源**，也不下载、不转存任何音频；所有播放行为发生在用户本机的洛雪中，音源由用户自行安装的第三方脚本提供。
- 洛雪是 [Apache-2.0 + 补充协议](https://lxmusic.toside.cn/desktop/license) 授权的第三方软件；本插件只调用其公开文档化的本地接口，不包含其代码。
- 请遵守各音乐平台的用户协议与版权规定；本插件不提供任何绕过付费/会员/版权保护的能力。

```bash
node --test test/*.test.mjs   # 纯函数单测（意图映射 / 播放校验 / 配置 / Scheme URL）
```

```
index.js        Host：工具、动态上下文、事件、/music-dj-api
client.js       Client：迷你播放条 + 设置页
lib/config.mjs  配置读写 + 默认场景表
lib/intent.mjs  意图 → 检索词；播放是否成功的判定（纯函数）

- [ ] v0.2：SSE `/subscribe-player-status` 实时同步（曲末自动续播不再依赖轮询）
- [ ] v0.2：`music_queue` 工具（AI 队列：一次排 5 首，曲末自动下一条）
- [ ] v0.3：第二个引擎适配器（`mpv + yt-dlp`，不装洛雪也能用）
- [ ] v0.3：音源健康检查（记住哪些场景词最近失败过，自动跳过）
- [ ] 持续：Windows 之外的平台实测（`-hidden`、Scheme 注册）

Turns a DeepSeek Harness conversation into an **AI DJ**: say "play something for coding" or "put on *Qingtian*", and DSH searches and switches tracks for you.

> **This plugin bundles no audio source, downloads no audio, and ships no source scripts.**
> It only turns words into search terms and drives a local **[LX Music](https://github.com/lyswhut/lx-music-desktop)** instance, which owns the sources and the playback.

---

| Typical music plugin | Music DJ |
| --- | --- |
| You maintain a local library | No library — LX Music already has the sources |
| The model can only pause/next | The model understands **intent**: scene, mood, or a specific song |
| Plugin ships decoders, proxies, lyrics, media keys | All delegated to LX Music; the plugin is a few dozen KB |
| You must ask to switch | With DJ mode on, the model switches at sensible moments |

readme.section: Prerequisites (the plugin cannot play audio by itself)
readme.text:
One-time setup:

1. Install **LX Music desktop ≥ 2.8** (≥ 2.12 recommended, for `-hidden`): [releases](https://github.com/lyswhut/lx-music-desktop/releases)
2. In LX Music, open **Settings → Custom Source** and import a working source script (LX has shipped no built-in sources since 2023; pick a community one — this plugin does not provide or distribute any)
3. Enable **Settings → Open API** (default port `23330`, bound to `127.0.0.1`)
4. In DSH, open **Settings → Music DJ → Test connection**

readme.section: Prerequisites (the plugin cannot play audio by itself)
readme.text: > Community sources expire. When playback fails the plugin says so honestly instead of pretending; swap the source and retry.

- **Market**: search "Music DJ / dsh-music-dj" in the DSH plugin market (recommended).
- **CLI**: `dsh plugin add dsh-music-dj` (the package declares `dsh.bundle`, so it is installable).
- **Local dev**: add an `insert` entry pointing at the package in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.

Just talk to DSH:

- "play something for coding" → scene-based search
- "play *Qingtian* by Jay Chou" → exact song, verified
- "something quieter" → re-query with the new intent
- "volume down" / "pause" / "next" → control
- "what's playing?" → reads real state

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `music_play` | Play by `intent`, `query`, or `title` + `artist` |
| `music_control` | `play/pause/toggle/next/prev/seek/volume/mute/collect/uncollect` |
| `music_status` | Connection diagnosis, current track, last error |

Every result is read back from the player: success tells you what is actually playing; failure tells you which queries were tried.

readme.section: How it works (why it is honest)
readme.text:
LX Music's Open API can control playback but **cannot search**; searching goes through Scheme URLs like `lxmusic://music/searchPlay/<terms>`, which are fire-and-forget. So the plugin uses both channels plus read-back verification:

```
intent → scene terms → candidate queries
   → dispatch lxmusic://music/searchPlay/<query>
   → poll http://127.0.0.1:23330/status every 800ms
   → verify playing + track changed / progress reset (title/artist match for exact requests)

Also included:

readme.section: How it works (why it is honest)

readme.text:
`~/.dsh/dsh-music-dj.json` (human-editable):

```json
{
  "engine": "lx",
  "lx": { "apiPort": 23330, "exe": "" },
  "dj": { "enabled": false, "cooldownMin": 10, "autoNext": false },

`dj.enabled` defaults to **false** — the plugin stays quiet unless you ask.

- The plugin bundles no sources, downloads no audio, and distributes no source scripts. Playback happens inside the user's own LX Music instance with sources the user installed.
- LX Music is Apache-2.0 plus a supplementary license; this plugin only calls its documented local interfaces and contains none of its code.
- Respect each platform's terms of service and copyright rules. No feature here bypasses paywalls, memberships, or DRM.

```bash
node --test test/*.test.mjs
```
